preparationSemantics.knownTransferCapture: Actual delivered 4,217,336-byte GLB streamed at a real 1MiB boundary before completion. Visible 1.0 / 4.0 MB status refers to that transfer.
preparationSemantics.progressMeaning: The rail represents menu-preparation units: decoded artwork, fonts, model transfer and first render. It is not a combined application-byte percentage. Failed resources settle into an explicitly disclosed degraded state.
preparationSemantics.unknownLength: No fabricated byte total or numeric percentage is presented. Full-width faint indeterminate gradient replaces the earlier scaled stub and avoids implying backwards preparation.
preparationSemantics.readyGate: Actual decoded artwork/font work and model first-render or explained fallback settlement determine readiness. Menu input remains blocked while the loading gate is active.
preparationSemantics.minimumWait: No artificial minimum loading time. The normal exit is a short visual transition; OS or saved reduced motion bypasses its delay.
preparationSemantics.slowWork: A slow-load notice can offer Continue while preparation finishes. The notice does not claim that pending work is complete.
